metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Vada Chennai
metas.description: A young carrom player in north Chennai becomes a reluctant participant in a war between two warring gangsters.

metas.name: ★ 9.4 · 2026 · Wanted
metas.description: Hyun-jun, an ordinary postman, is mistakenly arrested as a wanted criminal due to his identical appearance to fugitive Choi Cheol-gu. While struggling to prove his innocence, the real Cheol-gu escapes prison and flees to Taiwan. When Hyun-jun travels there on a reward trip, he is once again mistaken for the criminal and even kidnapped, only to be rescued by tough detective Woo-hee and her partner. As repeated mix-ups lead to comedic chaos, Hyun-jun and Woo-hee grow closer and ultimately team up to catch the real fugitive together.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · The Informant
metas.description: Tae-bong, an informant in a smuggling operation, gets exposed during his mission. Meanwhile, bumbling detective Nam-hyuk stumbles into the chaos while attempting his own scheme. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two must recover their losses and take down the criminals.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
metas.description: See an extended look at "Grand Theft Auto VI", the next evolution in the groundbreaking "Grand Theft Auto" series.

metas.name: 2026 · Kill Jackie
metas.description: Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Street Fighter
metas.description: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

metas.name: ★ 9.2 · 2026 · Comrade Kalyan
metas.description: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2014 · The Guest
metas.description: A soldier introduces himself to the Peterson family, claiming to be a friend of their son who died in action. After the young man is welcomed into their home, a series of accidental deaths seem to be connected to his presence.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Tomb Raider King
metas.description: God-like tombs surface globally, granting magical relics. Betrayed and left for dead, elite hunter Jooheon travels 15 years into the past to loot every tomb, hoard artifacts, and execute revenge.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Jailer 2
metas.description: A retired officer's peaceful life is disrupted when a dangerous criminal organization threatens his family. He must use his skills one final time to protect his loved ones and preserve his legacy.

metas.name: 2026 · VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: 2026 · Avatar: Seven Havens
metas.description: After a world-shattering disaster, a young Earthbender learns she's the post-Korra Avatar. Now seen as a harbinger of doom, she and her twin race to save the Seven Havens while pursued by humans and spirits alike.

metas.name: 2020 · The Weight
metas.description: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2023 · Believer 2
metas.description: A determined detective continues his search for the truth behind Asia's largest drug organization and its elusive boss he has unfinished business with.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2017 · The Prison
metas.description: A troubled ex-cop imprisoned for a hit-and-run accident discovers that the entire penitentiary is controlled by an inmate who has been running a crime syndicate with the help of the warden and guards which provides them 100% alibi.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2017 · The Swindlers
metas.description: Unlikely allies from different sides of the law must work together to achieve a common goal -- trapping the world's most legendary con man.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 1987 · Over the Top
metas.description: Tough trucker Lincoln Hawk is determined to win back his son and triumph at the world arm wrestling championships.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2024 · In the Land of Saints and Sinners
metas.description: A disillusioned hitman comes out of retirement for one last job when an IRA bomber on the run from the law arrives in his sleepy Irish village.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2002 · Blood Work
metas.description: Still recovering from a heart transplant, retired F.B.I. profiler Terry McCaleb returns to service when his own blood analysis offers clues to the identity of a serial killer.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 1990 · The Rookie
metas.description: A veteran detective is assigned a rookie partner after his previous partner is killed by a car theft gang. He is determined to apprehend those responsible for his friend's death but his new partner isn't really up to the task.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2007 · The Brave One
metas.description: Struggling to recover emotionally from a brutal assault that killed her fiancé and left her in a coma, a radio personality begins a quest for vengeance against the perpetrators that leaves a bloody trail across New York City.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2024 · Hijack 1971
metas.description: The movie depics the story of people fighting for their lives in an extreme situation when a passenger plane is hijacked in the airspace of Korea in 1971.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2019 · The Beast
metas.description: A criminal action movie about two detectives in conflict who solve a murder that shakes up the Korean peninsula.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2013 · Homefront
metas.description: A former DEA agent moves his family to a quiet town, where he soon tangles with a local meth druglord.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2005 · Sahara
metas.description: Master explorer Dirk Pitt goes on the adventure of a lifetime of seeking out a lost Civil War battleship known as the "Ship of Death" in the deserts of West Africa while helping a WHO doctor being hounded by a ruthless dictator.
